title: The Truth About Death
excerpt: No matter where you live or how well you take care of yourself, there's no escaping death. But for those who belong to Christ, that's not the end of the story — really, really good news.

blocks.text: No matter what part of this planet you live on, how well you take care of your body, or how much money is in your bank account, there is no escaping death.
Sound a little depressing? Sure. But there's still good news! Really, really good news.
For those who belong to Christ, we have a hope that's beyond this world…

verses: The Spirit of God, who raised Jesus from the dead, lives in you. And just as God raised Christ Jesus from the dead, he will give life to your mortal bodies by this same Spirit living within you.

blocks.text: Death is the greatest tool of our enemy, which is why Jesus came to defeat it. That's why He became human, took the ultimate punishment, and put death in its rightful place—under the authority and dominion of God.
For the believer, death is only temporary. And the Spirit of God can do what no human can—give life to the lifeless and redeem what has been lost.
The truth about death is that it's not the end of the story.

Soon, God will wipe away every tear and make all things new. Just as a baby is given the miraculous and mysterious breath of life, His Spirit will revive the seemingly perished and bring the dead back to life.
And that is the really, really good news.
We can know the One who made everything—who brings dead things back to life. Take a moment to thank God for who He is!

God, thank You for laying down Your life—for the world and for me. I don't deserve the grace, forgiveness, and salvation You've given me, but I'm so thankful. I want to live, now and forever, fully alive in You! Help me to tell others about Your resurrection power, and about the greatest story on earth. In Jesus' name, Amen.
